text:
nina: Heads-up — PR #8427 is ready for review but it's gated on an architecture brief / RFC. Can someone from arch take a look? PR: https://github.company/repo/pull/8427. Need merge before Friday for next release. @kevin any quick eyes?

devin: Added a concise summary to the PR description. Will attach RFC link shortly. SLO impact noted: p50 +3ms expected, p95 +8ms under load. No storage migration.

kevin: Quick clarifying Q: is this changing shard routing or KV cache semantics? If yes we need a tiny design note (2–3 bullets) + updated compatibility matrix. If not, a 1-paragraph rationale + perf numbers should be enough. :eyes:

devin: Not touching shard routing. This flips a config flag to enable continuous-batching fallback and adds a small shim in the runtime. Perf numbers in PR: p50 +3ms, p95 +8ms from our load runs. I'll drop RFC link in ~10m.

nina: Also need a canary window plan — can we do a 1hr canary during low traffic? @tal what slots are available today/tomorrow?

tal: We have a 1hr slot tomorrow 03:00–04:00 UTC or today 22:00–23:00 UTC. Prefer tomorrow for better eng coverage. Canary policy: start at 5% traffic, watch errors/latency, escalate to rollback on threshold. Will schedule once you confirm.

devin: RFC link: https://docs.internal/rfcs/CLD-297-minibatching. Short design + rollout section included. Also added an "Arch note" section in the PR with the rationale and perf tables.

kevin: Looking now. Two small asks: (1) add a short note about fallback behavior when GPU pool is saturated (what happens to requests and metric to watch), (2) include kv_cache_misses/sec as a canary metric. After those I'm fine to bless. :+1:

devin: Done — added both items to the RFC and PR under "Arch note". PTAL @kevin.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #8427 (unit / integration).

kevin: LGTM from arch. Recommend canary: 1hr at 5% traffic. Rollback thresholds: error rate +0.5% absolute OR p95 latency +15% relative.

tal: Confirmed — scheduling tomorrow 03:00–04:00 UTC. I've added the canary to the release calendar and will post in #deploy when we flip. Rollback conditions noted.

nina: Thanks all. I'll mark PR #8427 as ready-to-merge after the canary completes cleanly. :tada:
